titles.romaji: Dungeon Meshi: Senshi no Kantan Cooking!
titles.native: ダンジョン飯～センシのかんたんクッキング！

description: Stop-motion short in honor of the 5th tankoubon going on sale. It features Senshi's hands trying to prepare a walking mushroom. It is the same walking mushroom as shown in the manga's 1st volume in the "Monster Tidbits" bonus chapter.
